actual: The current workflow has the basic pieces, but Nightly/CI intake still needs stronger closure smoke/triage guarantees, successful commands still often print compact JSON objects, and code-intelligence refs are not fully surfaced in the fast path/batch/PR handoff.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: The current workflow has the basic pieces, but Nightly/CI intake still needs stronger closure smoke/triage guarantees, successful commands still often print compact JSON objects, and code-intelligence refs are not fully surfaced in the fast path/batch/PR handoff.
expected: Codex/Claude can use one standard workflow to triage Nightly/CI failures, receive concise human-readable success summaries, and consume CodeGraph/Understand Anything refs without broad repo scans or merge-blocking on graph availability.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
reproduce_command: python scripts/aistock_issue_workflow.py nightly-intake-smoke; python scripts/aistock_issue_workflow.py workflow-smoke --changed-file scripts/aistock_issue_workflow.py --module validation
title: Issue workflow needs closed-loop Nightly intake, human output, and deeper code intelligence

recommendations: Use compact success output; request full JSON only for failures or diagnostics.
Run targeted validation first, then final gates once the patch is stable.
Batch compatible workflow/CI/docs changes into one PR with per-issue evidence.
Keep validation_center_backend only when the changed files actually affect Validation Center.
